Measure genetic diversity within populations (heterozygosity)

Source: R/diversity.R
calc_heterozygosity.Rd

Calculates two measures of genetic diversity for each population (or super-population), averaged over all SNPs in the data.

Usage

calc_heterozygosity(x, by = c("pop", "super_pop"))

Arguments

x

A snpscape object.

by

Calculate per "pop" or per "super_pop".

Value

A tibble with one row per group: the group (pop and super_pop, or only super_pop), people, snps, observed and expected.

Details

A person is heterozygous at a SNP if they carry two different alleles (genotype count 1). Populations with more genetic diversity have more heterozygous people.

  • Observed heterozygosity is the proportion of genotypes that are heterozygous.

  • Expected heterozygosity (also called gene diversity) is the proportion we would expect if people paired up alleles at random within the population: 2p(1 - p) for allele frequency p, with a small correction for sample size.

The two are usually close. Observed heterozygosity clearly below expected can point to inbreeding or to hidden structure within a population.

Across the human genome, African populations have the highest diversity, and diversity decreases with distance from Africa. This is thought to reflect a series of population bottlenecks as small groups of people migrated out of Africa and across the world (the "serial founder effect").

The values depend on which SNPs are included. They are useful for comparing populations on the same set of SNPs, not as absolute numbers: for example, removing rare SNPs with filter_snps() raises the values.

Examples

example_lct |>
  filter_snps() |>
  calc_heterozygosity()
#> # A tibble: 26 × 6
#>    pop   super_pop people  snps observed expected
#>    <chr> <chr>      <int> <int>    <dbl>    <dbl>
#>  1 ACB   AFR           96   417   0.203    0.200 
#>  2 ASW   AFR           61   417   0.203    0.197 
#>  3 BEB   SAS           86   417   0.154    0.163 
#>  4 CDX   EAS           93   417   0.195    0.178 
#>  5 CEU   EUR           99   417   0.0786   0.0841
#>  6 CHB   EAS          103   417   0.180    0.187 
#>  7 CHS   EAS          105   417   0.201    0.187 
#>  8 CLM   AMR           94   417   0.162    0.158 
#>  9 ESN   AFR           99   417   0.199    0.200 
#> 10 FIN   EUR           99   417   0.134    0.123 
#> # ℹ 16 more rows
